en: Self-hosted runner: Added `--repository-folder` to name the folder that sessions use for a repository at `--capacity 1`, in place of its path under the base folder, which can't be a symbolic link
zh: 自托管运行器：新增 `--repository-folder`，用于在 `--capacity 1` 时指定 session 为仓库使用的文件夹，替代其在基础文件夹下的路径（该路径不能是符号链接）
